answer: I would anchor trust in Farcaster cast hash of the draft. With a cast that hashes the draft text, a single horizon check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. What the farm fears is not one hard check but a check that cannot be shared: a cast that hashes the draft text is per-account by construction, and the ledge is that the tenth clone costs as much as the first. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the canyon of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
